title: Syncopated build intent, version 1
description: One installer ISO for one workstation. Pass the file with `ansible-playbook playbooks/build.yml -e @profiles/<name>.yml`; the file holds a single top-level key, `intent`. playbooks/build.yml validates it against this schema before any other task.

name.description: Blueprint name: the outputs are <name>.toml, build-<name>.sh, <name>.credentials.txt and <name>-<commit>.iso.

distro.description: Target distribution as `image-builder list` names it (point releases for EL).

components.description: Hardware and software stack: names of roles/osbuild/files/<distro>/<major>/<arch>/components/<name>.yml. The hardening profile adds its openscap-* component itself.

hardening.description: OpenSCAP profile applied at build time with the workstation tailoring, or none.

size_gib.description: Declared size of the target disk in GiB (1 GiB = 1024^3 bytes; a 512 GB disk is 476 GiB). Volume sizes are computed from it; a smaller disk aborts the install, a larger one gives the surplus to /home.

encrypt.description: LUKS on the physical volume. The installer then asks for the passphrase (the only prompt).

tmp.description: /tmp in the hardened layout: tmpfs, or an 8 GiB volume (lv).

serial.description: When set, the install aborts unless the selected disk has this serial (lsblk -dno SERIAL).

users.description: Users the installer creates. Each gets the initial password (osbuild_initial_password, default "syncopated"; changed at first login) and the groups wheel + the components' user_groups + groups.

password_min_length.description: Minimum password length that the hardening profile enforces (pam_pwquality minlen; SSG variable var_password_pam_minlen). Defaults to the profile's value: 14 for CIS, 12 for PCI-DSS. Only cis-l2-workstation and pci-dss check it.

root.description: Root account. Locked by default (administration through sudo). enabled: true gives root the users' initial password (changed at first login).

remote_logging.description: Ship the journal (audit events included) to a log host with systemd-journal-upload over mTLS. Off by default; the workstation never depends on the log host.

ca_cert.description: PEM text or a path to a PEM file on the controller.

client_cert.description: PEM text or a path to a PEM file on the controller.

client_key.description: PEM text or a path to a PEM file on the controller.

package_pins.description: Version expression per package name, e.g. {python3: "3.12.*"}.
